memories.content: Lucia Ferreyra is the director of a nonprofit organization. She has prepared an unsolicited concept note for the Alder Foundation and intends to send it to the program officer. She hopes for a substantive response within a month.

The Alder Foundation is a philanthropic organization that accepts unsolicited concept notes. Lucia Ferreyra can send her concept note to the foundation's general submission channel or directly to the program officer if the address is known. The program officer typically reviews submissions and may or may not respond substantively.
